preconditions.description: The length of array A is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < len(A) for a in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is an integer within the range [0, N-1], where N is the length of A.
All elements in array A are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(find_cycle(A, i)) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: The function returns the length of the longest cycle in the array A.
